Theorem write_outside_region_isolated : forall (m : mem) (base size i j v : nat),
  in_region base size j -> ~ in_region base size i ->
  read (write m i v) j = read m j.
Proof.
  intros m base size i j v Hjin Hnin.
  (* auxiliary lemma about read after write *)
  assert (Hrw : forall m i v j,
      read (write m i v) j = if Nat.eqb i j then Some v else read m j).
  { induction m as [|x t IH] ; intros i v j; simpl.
    - (* m = [] *) reflexivity.
    - destruct i as [|i']; destruct j as [|j']; simpl.
      + (* i=0, j=0 *) rewrite Nat.eqb_refl. reflexivity.
      + (* i=0, j=S j' *) rewrite Nat.eqb_sym. simpl. rewrite Nat.eqb_neq; auto. reflexivity.
      + (* i=S i', j=0 *) rewrite Nat.eqb_sym. simpl. rewrite Nat.eqb_neq; auto. reflexivity.
      + (* i=S i', j=S j' *) rewrite Nat.eqb_sym. simpl. rewrite IH. reflexivity. }
  (* use the auxiliary lemma *)
  specialize (Hrw m i v j).
  rewrite Hrw.
  (* from the hypotheses we get i <> j *)
  assert (Hij : i <> j).
  { intro Heq.
    apply Hnin.
    subst j.
    destruct Hjin as [Hle _].
    split; [apply Hle|].
    (* j = i, and j is in region, so i is in region, contradiction *)
    rewrite <- Nat.add_1_r in *.
    (* we just need i < base+size, which follows from Hjin's second component *)
    destruct Hjin as [_ Hlt].
    exact Hlt. }
  (* now simplify the if *)
  apply Nat.eqb_neq in Hij.
  rewrite Hij. reflexivity.
